prompt:

Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-04-16):
| Return 3m            | +4.9% |
| Return 1m            | +5.5% |
| Return 1w            | +2.9% |
| Range position (63d) | 80% |
| 21d realized vol     | 29% |
| Last close           | 301.74 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has shown persistent short-term strength (1m and 3m gains) and sits high within its 63-day range (80% position), indicating continued upside momentum despite elevated realized vol (29%). The combination of constructive price action and tight recent range positioning supports a favorable near-term stance for roughly the next 20 trading days.

DECISION: BUY
